name: bandrad-crm-api-Flow
description: Beginner-friendly CRM to HDB portal automation

scripts.start:hdb: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && node scripts/runHdbVerificationWorker.js --headed
scripts.debug:hdb: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && node --inspect scripts/runHdbVerificationWorker.js --headed --debug
scripts.debug:hdb:inspector: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && set PWDEBUG=1&& node scripts/runHdbVerificationWorker.js --headed
scripts.update-status:dev: npm run env:dev && playwright test tests/updateStatus.spec.js --headed
